form:FormGroup.label: State Value Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: The data type used to store values. Fixed-size types (Boolean to Double) are compact; String stores text; the lookup table types de-duplicate values to save space at some cost to speed; Variable stores short values directly and longer ones in a lookup table. Default is Variable.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Fixed-size types are compact; lookup tables are smaller but slower. Default is Variable.

form:FormGroup.label: Hash Length
form:FormGroup.helpText: The size of the hash used by the Hash lookup table and Variable value types: Integer (4 bytes) or Long (8 bytes). Only enabled for those types. Default is Integer.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Integer (4 bytes) or Long (8 bytes); only used by hash lookup and Variable types.
